purpose: Optional future work order for commissioning redistributable real-instrument recordings that may replace current external-only references after the release.

recording_environment.room: quiet room or studio with low background noise
recording_environment.microphone: external microphone preferred; phone recording accepted only if noise floor and clipping pass review
recording_environment.processing: dry recording only; no reverb, EQ, compression, noise reduction, pitch correction, time stretching, or backing track
recording_environment.format: wav or aiff, 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz, 24-bit preferred, mono or stereo accepted before mastering

legal_delivery.attribution: record performer name, instrument, recording date, and license terms in release JSON
legal_delivery.composition_rule: single notes, scales, original gestures, percussion hits, or public-domain material only

acceptance_flow: Receive all take files and <instrument_id>.release.json in the delivery folder.
Run import_verified_audio.py without --approve for technical conversion preview.
Only after license, technical, and professional review pass, rerun import_verified_audio.py with --approve.
hard_reject_conditions: recording contains AI, VST, sample library, keyboard, or synthesized tone
audio was ripped from YouTube, CD, streaming, broadcast, or social media
background music, accompaniment, applause, talking, traffic, or room noise masks the instrument
file is clipped, heavily compressed, reverbed, pitch corrected, or noise-reduced
release file is missing or does not grant commercial app distribution and derivative processing
